result.title: Agent-Controlled Forgetting for Tool-Using Agents: Reversible Context Curation in Practice
result.comment: 13 pages, 1 figure. Code and research artifacts: https://github.com/boldprojekte/agent-forgetting-research
result.summary: Tool-using agents repeatedly carry observations whose useful content can be much smaller than their original payload. We study agent-controlled forgetting: the acting model selects previously observed tool results, replaces each with a short note at its original position, and retains the exact original in a recoverable archive. A Python harness exposes batch archival and explicit recovery without task-specific model training, while protecting user instructions and assistant messages from these operations. In an exploratory OpenTelemetry debugging case followed by an unrelated implementation task, the method ended with 231,951 provider-reported prompt tokens versus 912,492 under retained history, used 50% fewer cumulative input tokens, and had an estimated API cost of USD 1.28-1.44 versus approximately USD 4.38. Both arms passed the two-case primary behavioral oracle; neither fully satisfied the follow-up evaluation. The method made more requests and took 17% longer. A contrasting application-development pair produced no context or cost saving, and an earlier continuation exhibited lower manually assessed quality despite reduced context. These observations demonstrate substantial resource savings in noisy tool-use trajectories and identify workload dependence as a central consideration for reversible context management.

AI.brief_summary: 研究工具智能体中的「可逆遗忘」：由模型自行选取此前的工具结果，在原位替换为短注记并把原文存入可恢复归档，无需任务专属训练。在 OpenTelemetry 调试案例中显著降低 prompt token 与成本，但请求数更多、耗时增加约 17%，且节省效果依赖负载类型，延续任务上人工质量评估反而下降。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「由模型自主决定压缩哪些历史观测、并保留可恢复原文」的机制，可供核查是否迁移到 VLM 推理中的视觉证据筛选与状态压缩；但该工作处理文本上下文而非 latent 状态，迁移可能性需人工确认。
